title: Fundamentals for Binary Classification Under Label Noise
abstract: arXiv:2611.25372v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This chapter surveys fundamental results for binary classification under label noise. Binary classification under label noise involves training models on datasets where class labels are partially incorrect, leading to degraded performance and misclassification. We distinguish poisoning attacks from noise processes and formalize random classification noise, Massart noise, and malicious classification noise within the probably approximately correct (PAC) framework. These models capture different adversarial strengths and data-generation realities. We then highlight some core ideas and representative results. translated_title: 标签噪声下二分类的基础理论
translated_abstract: 本章综述了标签噪声下二分类的基础性研究成果。标签噪声下的二分类是指在一部分类别标签不正确的数据集上训练模型，这会导致模型性能下降和误分类问题。我们区分了投毒攻击与噪声过程，并在可能近似正确（PAC）框架下形式化了随机分类噪声、Massart 噪声和恶意分类噪声这三种噪声模型，它们刻画了不同的对抗强度和数据生成场景。随后，我们重点介绍了一些核心思想与代表性结果。特别地，我们解释了为什么随机分类噪声能够保持假设之间的期望排序，从而支持基于经验风险最小化（ERM）原则的学习；样本复杂度如何依赖于噪声率；以及为什么学习算法通常需要对污染水平设定一个上界，还有如何成功地……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本章系统综述了标签噪声下二分类学习的基础理论，在 PAC 框架下形式化了随机分类噪声、Massart 噪声和恶意分类噪声三种模型，并阐明了经验风险最小化的适用条件以及样本复杂度与噪声率之间的关系。
en_tdlr: This chapter surveys the fundamental theory of binary classification under label noise, formalizing random classification noise, Massart noise, and malicious classification noise within the PAC framework, and explaining when ERM remains valid and how sample complexity depends on the noise rate.
